title: Parameterized Problems Complete for Nondeterministic FPT Time and Logarithmic Space
authors: Hans L. Bodlaender (Utrecht University, The Netherlands), Carla Groenland (Utrecht University, The Netherlands), Jesper Nederlof (Utrecht University, The Netherlands), Céline M. F. Swennenhuis (Eindhoven University of Technology, The Netherlands)
abstract: Let $\mathrm{XNLP}$ be the class of parameterized problems such that an instance of size $n$ with parameter $k$ can be solved nondeterministically in time $f(k)n^{O(1)}$ and space $f(k)\log(n)$ (for some computable function $f$). We give a wide variety of $\mathrm{XNLP}$-complete problems, such as {\sc List Coloring} and {\sc Precoloring Extension} with pathwidth as parameter, {\sc Scheduling of Jobs with Precedence Constraints}, with both number of machines and partial order width as parameter, {\sc Bandwidth} and variants of {\sc Weighted CNF-Satisfiability} and reconfiguration problems. In particular, this implies that all these problems are $\mathrm{W}[t]$-hard for all $t$. This also answers a long standing question on the parameterized complexity of the {\sc Bandwidth} problem.
